tools.name: compute_tax
tools.description: Deterministic Indian income tax computation for a fiscal year. Handles new/old regime slabs, standard deduction, 87A rebate with marginal relief (threshold tested on TOTAL income per the statute; rebate never offsets 111A/112A tax under the new regime), employer NPS under 80CCD(2) in both regimes, house-property loss (self-occupied interest capped by s.24(b), not deductible under 115BAC; set-off capped by s.71(3A); none under 115BAC), 111A/112A capital gains rates with the basic-exemption set-off, surcharge (with the 15% cap on gains and marginal relief), and 4% cess (FY 2025-26 figures). All arithmetic is done in code from a versioned rule pack -- never estimated.

regime.description: Tax regime. 'new' (115BAC) is the default regime since FY 2023-24.

salaryIncome.description: Gross salary income in INR, before standard deduction

otherIncome.description: Other normal-rate income in INR (interest, net rent, etc.)

stcg111A.description: Short-term capital gains under section 111A (listed equity, STT paid) in INR

ltcg112A.description: Long-term capital gains under section 112A in INR, BEFORE the Rs 1,25,000 exemption

deductions.description: Old regime only: total Chapter VI-A deductions (80C, 80D, ...) in INR, EXCLUDING employer NPS (use employerNps80CCD2). Ignored under the new regime.

employerNps80CCD2.description: Employer's NPS contribution under s.80CCD(2) in INR. Allowed in BOTH regimes (the one Chapter VI-A deduction 115BAC keeps); capped at 14% of salary in the new regime, 10% (private) / 14% (government) in the old (FY 2025-26).

governmentEmployer.description: Central/State Government employer (raises the old-regime 80CCD(2) cap to 14% for FY 2025-26)

housePropertyLoss.description: Loss under the head house property as a POSITIVE number: home-loan interest on the house you live in, or a let-out property's net loss. Requires housePropertyType. Old regime: set off against other heads up to Rs 2,00,000 (s.71(3A)). New regime: no inter-head set-off (s.115BAC(2)). Figures for FY 2025-26.

housePropertyType.description: Required when housePropertyLoss is above 0. 'selfOccupied': the home you live in; its interest is deductible only up to Rs 2,00,000 in the old regime (s.24(b)) and not at all in the new regime (s.115BAC(2)(i)), and what is above that is neither set off nor carried forward. 'letOut': no s.24(b) cap; the part not set off is carried forward (s.71B).

ageBand.description: Age band: below60, senior (60-79), superSenior (80+). Affects old-regime exemption only.

tools.name: compare_regimes
tools.description: Compute tax under BOTH regimes for the same income and return a side-by-side comparison with the recommended regime and the savings amount. Pass the old-regime deductions you could actually claim; the new regime ignores them.

salaryIncome.description: Gross salary income in INR, before standard deduction

otherIncome.description: Other normal-rate income in INR (interest, net rent, etc.)

stcg111A.description: Short-term capital gains under section 111A (listed equity, STT paid) in INR

tools.name: schedule_advance_tax
tools.description: Build the advance tax installment plan (06-15 at 15%, 09-15 at 45%, 12-15 at 75%, 03-15 at 100% cumulative, MM-DD, FY 2025-26) for an estimated tax liability net of TDS. Reports per-installment amounts and shortfalls against what has been paid so far.

estimatedTax.description: Estimated total tax liability for the FY in INR (use compute_tax first)

tdsExpected.description: TDS/TCS expected to be deducted during the year in INR

paidSoFar.description: Advance tax already paid per installment, in order

tools.name: list_deductions
tools.description: Return the old-regime deduction checklist with statutory caps for a fiscal year (80C, 80CCD(1B), 80D tiers, 80TTA/TTB, 24(b), HRA metro list). Useful for estimating the `deductions` input to compute_tax/compare_regimes.

tools.name: parse_form26as
tools.description: Parse the caret-delimited Form 26AS TEXT export from TRACES into structured TDS entries (deductor, TAN, section, amounts, booking status) with totals, plus TCS rows (206C*) separated into tcsEntries. Reports creditableTdsDeposited (status F rows only) alongside the raw total. Download the 'Text' format from TRACES (the archive opens with your DOB as DDMMYYYY); PDF exports are not supported.

path.description: Absolute path to the 26AS .txt file downloaded from TRACES

tools.name: parse_ais
tools.description: Decrypt and parse the AIS JSON export from the income tax portal, entirely on-device. Provide pan + dob (DDMMYYYY) to derive the password, or pass it explicitly. Returns taxpayer info, normalized information rows (TDS entries, SFT transactions) with amounts, dates, and codes extracted by column label, and `totals` summed in code: every section/element/code group with its row count and amount (each group's `key` is what reconcile_documents takes as interestGroups/dividendGroups), and salary per employer TAN from section 192 TDS rows. Never add up rows yourself. The decryption scheme is reverse-engineered from the AIS utility; if it fails, use the portal's CSV export as a fallback and file an issue.

path.description: Absolute path to the downloaded AIS .json file

pan.description: PAN (used to derive the decryption password)

dob.description: Date of birth as DDMMYYYY (or DD-MM-YYYY); date of incorporation for non-individuals. NOT ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: compute_interest_234
tools.description: Deterministic sections 234A, 234B and 234C interest (FY 2025-26 rates). 234A: 1%/month for filing after the due date, on tax outstanding after all prepaid tax. 234B: 1%/month on assessed-minus-advance when advance < 90% (from 1 April of the AY), reduced by self-assessment payments under s.140A. 234C: per-installment shortfalls with the statutory 12%/36% safe harbors for June/September, measured on tax due on RETURNED income. Rule 119A rounding applied (principal floored to Rs 100, part month = full month). Pass dates (filingDate with form, paidOrAssessedDate, payment dates) and the tool counts the months; month counts are still accepted. Each section is computed only when its own inputs are supplied; anything skipped is named in `skipped`.

assessedTax.description: 234B base: tax on total income minus TDS/TCS and reliefs, in INR (advance tax is NOT deducted here)

advanceTaxPaid.description: Total advance tax paid during the FY, in INR

monthsFor234B.description: Months from 1 April of the AY to the date of payment or assessment (part month = full month). Prefer paidOrAssessedDate or filingDate and let the tool count. Filing on 20 July of the AY is 4.

paidOrAssessedDate.description: 234B end date (YYYY-MM-DD): when the outstanding tax is paid in full, or the assessment date. Defaults to filingDate. The tool counts the months from 1 April of the AY (Rule 119A, part month = full month).

filingDate.description: Date the return is or will be filed (YYYY-MM-DD). Drives 234A (needs `form` or `dueDate`) and, unless paidOrAssessedDate is given, the end of 234B.

form.description: ITR form, used with filingDate to pick the non-audit s.139(1) due date from the rule pack for 234A

dueDate.description: Explicit s.139(1) due date (YYYY-MM-DD) for 234A, e.g. an audit case. Overrides `form`.

selfAssessmentPayments.description: Self-assessment tax paid under s.140A before assessment: each payment stops 234B interest on that amount from its own month (s.234B(2))

monthsFromApril.description: Months from 1 April of the AY to this payment (part month = full month). Prefer `date`.

date.description: Date of this s.140A payment (YYYY-MM-DD); the tool counts the months

taxDueOnReturnedIncome.description: 234C base: tax due on RETURNED income minus TDS/TCS/reliefs, in INR. Defaults to assessedTax when omitted.

cumulativePaid.description: Cumulative (running-total) advance tax paid by Jun 15 / Sep 15 / Dec 15 / Mar 15, in INR. Required for 234C.

presumptive.description: 44AD/44ADA presumptive: a single 100% installment by 03-15 (MM-DD) instead of four

monthsLateFiling.description: 234A: months from the day after the due date to the date of filing (part month = full month). 0 means filed on time. Prefer filingDate with `form` and let the tool count.

taxOutstandingFor234A.description: 234A base: tax outstanding after TDS/TCS, advance tax, AND reliefs, in INR. Defaults to assessedTax minus advanceTaxPaid.

taxOutstandingForms234A.description: Deprecated misspelling of taxOutstandingFor234A; still accepted.

tools.name: compute_hra
tools.description: HRA exemption per Rule 2A: least of (actual HRA, rent minus 10% of salary, 50% metro / 40% non-metro of salary), computed period-wise. Salary = basic + retirement-forming DA + fixed-percentage turnover commission. Old regime only. Give each period's city: the tool checks it against the fy's rule-pack metro list (FY 2025-26: Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai). Also computes the 80GG alternative for rent payers who received no HRA at any time in the year (the two are mutually exclusive).

periods.description: Homogeneous periods (amounts are per-period TOTALS, not monthly). Split whenever salary, rent, HRA, or city changes. Required unless eightyGG is supplied.

months.description: Months in this period; all periods must total 12

basic.description: Basic salary for the PERIOD in INR

daRetirement.description: DA forming part of retirement benefits, for the period

turnoverCommission.description: Commission at a fixed percentage of turnover, per Gestetner

hraReceived.description: HRA actually received for the period in INR

rentPaid.description: Rent actually paid for the period in INR

city.description: City of the rented home, e.g. 'Pune'. The tool checks it against the fy's rule-pack metro list, which changes between years, so pass the city rather than deciding metro status yourself.

isMetro.description: Only when the city cannot be named: true if the rented home is in one of the fy's rule-pack metro cities (list_deductions returns them as hraMetros). Ignored when `city` is given.

regime.description: HRA exemption and 80GG are both unavailable under the new regime

eightyGG.description: Compute the 80GG alternative instead of HRA (requires: no HRA received at any time in the year)

rentPaid.description: Total rent paid in the year, INR

adjustedTotalIncome.description: Total income before 80GG, excluding LTCG, 111A STCG, and other Chapter VI-A deductions

months.description: Months rent was paid; the cap limb is Rs 5,000 PER MONTH (FY 2025-26)

hraReceivedAnyMonth.description: True if any HRA was received at any time in the year, which bars 80GG outright

tools.name: reconcile_documents
tools.description: Cross-document mismatch report -- the checks that pre-empt 143(1)(a) intimations and 139(9) defect notices: TDS claimed vs 26AS deposited (the ledger of record), missing-employer detection, AIS interest/dividend vs declared, Form 16 vs 26AS per-TAN totals, declared salary below the Form 16 total, and 26AS rows missing the gross amount. Also groups 26AS TDS by income head so each credit can be placed in the right schedule. Prefer the file inputs: form26asPath reads the 26AS export itself, and aisFile decrypts the AIS and sums the groups you name, so no row or total is copied by hand. Pass whichever documents you have; checks needing missing inputs are reported as skipped.

form26asPath.description: Absolute path to the 26AS TRACES Text export (.txt). Parsed here, so the rows never pass through your arguments. Use instead of form26asTds.

aisFile.description: The AIS export itself: salary by TAN is taken from section 192 TDS rows, and interest/dividend are the code-summed totals of the groups you name. Any figure given in `ais` overrides the file's.

path.description: Absolute path to the AIS JSON download

pan.description: PAN, to derive the decryption password

interestGroups.description: Keys from parse_ais totals.groups to count as interest. Name each source once: a bank can report the same interest as a TDS row and again as an SFT row.

dividendGroups.description: Keys from parse_ais totals.groups to count as dividend, each source once

form26asTds.description: TDS entries from parse_form26as (tdsEntries, not tcsEntries)

amountPaid.description: Amount paid or credited in INR (may be negative on a correction row)

tdsDeposited.description: TDS deposited in INR (may be negative on a correction row)

status.description: TRACES booking status from parse_form26as: F (final, creditable), P (provisional), U (unmatched), O (overbooked)

tan.description: Employer TAN from Form 16 Part A

grossSalary.description: GROSS salary per Form 16 Part B, before exemptions

tdsDeposited.description: Total TDS deposited per Form 16 Part A, in INR

ais.description: AIS aggregates, when you have figures rather than the file. Take them from parse_ais `totals` (summed in code), never by adding rows yourself; prefer aisFile.

salaryByTan.description: AIS gross salary keyed by employer TAN

interestTotal.description: Total AIS interest across all banks, in INR

tdsClaimed.description: Total TDS credit claimed in the draft return

salaryDeclared.description: Gross salary declared in the draft return, in INR

tools.name: recommend_itr_form
tools.description: Recommend ITR-1/2/3/4 for an individual from income heads, residency, losses, and disqualifier flags, with rule-by-rule reasoning. Loss-continuity aware: brought-forward business/speculative losses force ITR-3 even with zero current-year business income (Schedule CFL). Checks the 44AD/44ADA turnover ceilings when presumptiveTurnover is supplied, the 44AE vehicle limit when vehicles44AE is supplied, and the ITR-1/ITR-4 house-property limit (2 for AY 2026-27). Returns the filing deadline with its statutory citation, the belated and revised deadlines, and the 234F late fee.

residency.description: Residential status for the FY (RNOR/NRI cannot file ITR-1/ITR-4)

totalIncome.description: Estimated TOTAL income in INR, i.e. after Chapter VI-A deductions -- this is the figure the Rs 50,00,000 ITR-1/ITR-4 ceiling tests (AY 2026-27). Use the gross figure only if you have no deductions.

houseProperties.description: Number of house properties with income or loss (ITR-1/ITR-4 admit up to 2 for AY 2026-27)

stcg111A.description: STCG under 111A in INR (any amount rules out ITR-1/ITR-4)

ltcg112A.description: LTCG under 112A in INR before the Rs 1,25,000 exemption

hasOtherCapitalGains.description: Capital gains outside 111A/112A: property, debt MF, unlisted or foreign shares

hasBusinessIncome.description: Any business or professional income this year, incl. F&O trading and freelancing

presumptiveScheme.description: Which presumptive section (drives the turnover ceiling check; defaults to 44AD)

presumptiveTurnover.description: 44AD turnover or 44ADA gross receipts in INR. Above Rs 2,00,00,000 (Rs 3,00,00,000 with cash receipts within 5%) / Rs 50,00,000 (Rs 75,00,000) the scheme lapses and ITR-3 with audit applies (FY 2025-26). Omit to skip the check.

cashReceiptsWithin5Pct.description: Cash receipts are at most 5% of turnover/receipts (lifts the 44AD/44ADA ceiling to Rs 3,00,00,000 / Rs 75,00,000 for FY 2025-26)

hasNonPresumptiveBusiness.description: Also has business/professional income OUTSIDE the presumptive scheme (ITR-4 cannot carry both)

vehicles44AE.description: 44AE only: the most goods carriages owned at any time in the year (the scheme allows up to 10). Omit to skip the check.

businessLoss.description: Non-speculative business loss (incl. F&O) brought forward or arising this year

speculativeLoss.description: Speculative (intraday equity) loss brought forward or arising this year

capitalLoss.description: Capital loss (STCL/LTCL) brought forward or to carry forward

housePropertyLoss.description: House property loss to carry forward

hasForeignAssetsOrIncome.description: Foreign assets/income incl. vested RSUs or ESPP of a foreign parent (Schedule FA)

isDirector.description: Director in any company during the FY

holdsUnlistedShares.description: Held unlisted equity shares during the FY

agriIncome.description: Agricultural income in INR (above Rs 5,000 rules out ITR-1/ITR-4)

hasLotteryOrGamingIncome.description: Winnings from lottery, online games, or racehorses

tds194N.description: TDS was deducted under s.194N on cash withdrawals (rules out ITR-1)

tools.name: filing_checklist
tools.description: Ordered, form-specific walkthrough for filing ITR-1/2/3/4 on incometax.gov.in: documents to gather, reconciliation, tax computation, portal steps schedule by schedule, and e-verification. Guidance only -- the taxpayer performs the final submit on the portal themselves.

form.description: The ITR form to file (use recommend_itr_form if unsure)

tools.name: list_tax_years
tools.description: List the fiscal years this server has rule packs for, with filing deadlines for the current assessment year.
